normative_extracts.spec_section: File System Living Standard §5 Origin Private File System
normative_extracts.quote: The origin private file system is a storage endpoint private to the origin of the page, optimized for performance, with synchronous access handles available inside dedicated workers.

browser_support.notes: FileSystemSyncAccessHandle is Baseline Widely Available in Dedicated Workers.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: OPFS maps directly to sandboxed OS file descriptors, allowing Dedicated Workers to perform synchronous in-place read/write syscalls via FileSystemSyncAccessHandle.

production_failures.symptom: NoModificationAllowedError when two tabs open the same SQLite-over-OPFS database
production_failures.root_cause: createSyncAccessHandle() acquires an exclusive OS-level lock on the file; a second worker calling it on the same file fails.
production_failures.mitigation: Coordinate file ownership across tabs with Web Locks (navigator.locks.request) before calling createSyncAccessHandle().

production_failures.symptom: Data loss on tab close after writing via FileSystemSyncAccessHandle
production_failures.root_cause: OS page cache buffers writes until flush() and close() are called.
production_failures.mitigation: Call accessHandle.flush() after critical transactions and accessHandle.close() on shutdown.
